🚨 NEWS ALERT | EUR ECB President Lagarde Speech
⏰ Release: 08:30 GMT

💡 WHAT IT IS
Central-bank policy or guidance. Tone and rate expectations can reprice currencies, gold and crypto quickly.

🟢 POSITIVE for EUR - Stronger / more hawkish than expected
📈 EUR stronger. EURUSD tends to rise.

🔴 NEGATIVE for EUR - Weaker / more dovish than expected
📉 EUR weaker. EURUSD tends to fall.

⚡ WHAT TO EXPECT
Sharp two-way volatility and wider spreads in the first minutes after release. The first move often reverses, so avoid chasing it. Consider reducing size or waiting for the market to settle.
